title: Marginal Calibration Masks Generator Differences in Held-Out Evaluation of Multivariate Time Series, with an Application to ERA5 Weather Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2609.33761v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative models for multivariate time series are routinely evaluated with pooled distributional metrics computed after marginal calibration. We show that, under a held-out protocol, the calibrated Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) distance differs from a real-versus-real floor by at most the distance of the calibrated sample to the training block, so that it carries little information about the generator. We audit a three-discriminator GAN with evolutionary weight adaptation (StatD2GAN) against re-implemented RCGAN and TimeGAN baselines on ERA5 weather sequences under a pre-specified protocol: the final two calendar years are held out behind a 168 hour embargo, calibration is fitted on the training block only, and the decision rules were frozen in advance. Evidence comes from 25 matched (location, seed) pairs across five locations, tested with Holm-corrected Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. First, isotonic calibration drives KS to a median of 1.0

translated_title: 边际校准在多变量时间序列留出评估中掩盖了生成器差异——以ERA5天气序列为例的应用
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列生成模型通常采用边际校准后计算的池化分布指标进行评估。我们证明，在留出协议下，校准后的Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）距离与“真实对真实”的基准下限之间的差异至多等于校准样本到训练块的距离，因此该指标几乎不携带关于生成器本身的信息。我们在预先指定的协议下，将具有进化权重自适应机制的三判别器GAN（StatD2GAN）与重新实现的RCGAN和TimeGAN基线模型在ERA5天气序列上进行了审计：最后两个日历年经168小时禁运期后被留出，校准仅在训练块上拟合，决策规则事先冻结。证据来自五个地点的25组匹配的（地点，随机种子）对，并使用Holm校正的Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行分析。首先，等保序回归校准使KS距离的中位数达到1.0
tldr: 该论文证明了在多变量时间序列生成模型的留出评估中，边际校准会使KS距离几乎不携带生成器信息，从而掩盖不同生成模型之间的真实差异，并通过ERA5天气序列上StatD2GAN与RCGAN、TimeGAN的对比实验验证了这一结论。
en_tdlr: Marginal calibration renders the held-out KS distance nearly uninformative about the generator in multivariate time series evaluation, masking true differences between generative models such as StatD2GAN, RCGAN, and TimeGAN on ERA5 weather sequences.
